preconditions.description: The two words must be of the same length to be anagrams.

preconditions.expression: all(char.lower() in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for char in word1) and all(char.lower() in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for char in word2)
preconditions.description: Both words must contain only alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The function returns true if the sorted characters of both words are equal, indicating they are anagrams.
